basic_info.description: Welcome to this wonderful Bernal Heights homea modern architectural beauty blending historical charm w/ modern luxury. Ideally located just steps from Precita park & a lovely neighborhood caf, this rare offering boasts over 2,800SF of thoughtfully designed living space across 2 dwelling units. Rebuilt in 2015, the tri-level main residence features a stunning open-concept grand room that flows seamlessly onto a fantastic deck overlooking the beautifully landscaped backyard complete w/ a custom integrated circular bench around a vintage tree. W/ 4 spacious BD plus an office, 3.5 modern BA, & 2 rear decks/patio this home offers both versatility & style. The expansive primary suite includes a sun-drenched, protected deckperfect for quiet mornings. Entertain w/ ease in the gourmet kitchen, elegant dining area, & open plan LR complete w/ a sleek, modern fireplace, integrated beautifully in the custom wall & paneling. The lower-level in-law studio offers a private retreat w/ a full kitchen, in-unit laundry, full BA, and its own private patioideal for guests, extended family, or rental income. The garage provides ample space for 2 cars & storage space to complete this exceptional property. A true Bernal gem-just private enough up the street, but moments away from the park.
